title: Silver Support for older seniors in smaller flats and CPF LIFE top-ups for low-wage seniors
asked: Mr Shawn Loh asked whether the highest tier of Silver Support can go to seniors above age 80 living in smaller HDB flats, and whether the Government can top up the CPF LIFE accounts of low-wage seniors who continue to work.
response: Dr Tan See Leng said Silver Support is a targeted scheme for seniors aged 65 and above who had lower working-year incomes and now have little or no family support. Eligibility depends on lifetime wages, housing type and household support, and eligible seniors in smaller flats with fewer resources get higher payments. He listed other support: the Workfare Income Supplement and Earn and Save Bonus under the Majulah Package, which can increase CPF LIFE payouts; the one-off Retirement Savings Bonus and MediSave Bonus; and the Assurance Package. Seniors needing more help can apply for ComCare at their nearest Social Service Office.
